title: Global
description: Global settings that affect everyone that uses this Roku device.

children.title: Remember Me?
children.description: Remember the currently logged in user and try to log them in again next time you start the JellyRock app.

children.title: Splash Screen Image
children.description: Control whether the server's splash screen image is displayed on the User Select screen. Server admin must enable this feature in branding settings.

title: Playback
description: Settings relating to playback and supported codec and media types.

children.title: Bitrate Limit
children.description: Configure the maximum playback bitrate.

children.title: Enable Limit
children.description: Enable or disable the 'Maximum Bitrate' setting.

children.title: Maximum Bitrate
children.description: Set the maximum bitrate in Mbps. Set to 0 to use Roku's specifications. This setting must be enabled to take effect.

children.title: Cinema Mode
children.description: Bring the theater experience straight to your living room with the ability to play custom intros before the main feature.

children.title: Custom Subtitles
children.description: Use custom subtitle rendering for external VTT subtitle files. Enables fallback fonts from the server and removes some formatting tags from misformatted subtitles. Note: May not fully support all Roku caption preferences.

children.title: Decode Multichannel Audio
children.description: Allow the Roku to decode multichannel audio formats (AAC, FLAC, etc.) to stereo. When disabled, forces the server to transcode to 2-channel audio instead of relying on Roku's downmix, which may improve audio quality on some systems.

children.title: Language Preferences
children.description: Override the web client's audio and subtitle language preferences for this device.

children.title: Audio Language Preference
children.description: Override the web client's audio language preference. Controls which language audio track is preferred during playback.

children.title: Custom Audio Language Code
children.description: Enter a 3-letter ISO 639-2 language code (e.g., eng, jpn, fra, deu, spa).

children.title: Subtitle Language Preference
children.description: Override the web client's subtitle language preference. Controls which language subtitle track is preferred during playback.

children.title: Custom Subtitle Language Code
children.description: Enter a 3-letter ISO 639-2 language code (e.g., eng, jpn, fra, deu, spa).

children.title: Maximum Resolution
children.description: Configure the maximum resolution when transcoding video files to this device.

options.title: Off - Attempt to direct play all resolutions

children.title: Media Segments
children.description: Control how media segments (Intro, Outro, etc.) are handled during playback. Requires Jellyfin server 10.10.0 or newer with segment detection configured.

children.title: Commercial Action
children.description: Action to take when a Commercial segment is detected during playback.

children.title: Intro Action
children.description: Action to take when an Intro segment is detected during playback.

children.title: Outro Action
children.description: Action to take when an Outro segment is detected during playback.

children.title: Preview Action
children.description: Action to take when a Preview segment is detected during playback.

children.title: Recap Action
children.description: Action to take when a Recap segment is detected during playback.

children.title: Unknown Action
children.description: Action to take when an Unknown segment type is detected during playback.

children.title: Next Episode Button Time
children.description: Set how many seconds before the end of an episode the Next Episode button should appear. Set to 0 to disable.

children.title: Play Default Audio Track
children.description: Override web client audio preference. When enabled, use the IsDefault flag to select audio track. When disabled, prefer language match and ignore IsDefault.

children.title: Play Next Episode Automatically
children.description: When finished playing a single episode, play the next one automatically.

children.title: Preferred Surround Audio Codec
children.description: When transcoding multichannel audio, prefer this codec. EAC3 supports up to 7.1 channels with better compression. AC3 is more widely compatible. DTS is an alternative for systems that prefer it. This only affects 6 and 8 channel transcoding profiles.

children.title: Preserve DoVi
children.description: Preserve Dolby Vision content when possible by forcing remux instead of direct playback when using MKV container files. This ensures proper Dolby Vision playback on supported devices.

children.title: Text Subtitles Only
children.description: Only display text subtitles to minimize transcoding.

children.title: Video Codec Support
children.description: Enable or disable Direct Play support for certain codecs.

children.title: Force Transcode Anamorphic Video
children.description: Force transcoding of anamorphic video (non-square pixels). Enable this if you see squished or stretched video during playback.

children.title: MPEG-2
children.description: Support Direct Play of MPEG-2 content (e.g., Live TV). This will prevent transcoding of MPEG-2 content, but uses significantly more bandwidth.

children.title: MPEG-4
children.description: Support Direct Play of MPEG-4 content. This may need to be disabled for playback of DIVX encoded video files.

children.title: Video Profile Level Support
children.description: Attempt Direct Play of potentially unsupported profile levels

children.title: H.264
children.description: Attempt Direct Play for H.264 media with unsupported profile levels before falling back to transcoding if it fails.

children.title: HEVC
children.description: Attempt Direct Play for HEVC media with unsupported profile levels before falling back to transcoding if it fails.

title: User Interface
description: Settings relating to how the application looks.

children.title: General
children.description: Settings relating to the appearance of the Home screen and the program in general.

children.title: Backdrop Images
children.description: Control display of backdrop images throughout the app. Enable for full visual experience, disable for better performance or accessibility.

children.title: Episode Images Next Up
children.description: What type of images to use for Episodes shown in the 'Next Up' and 'Continue Watching' sections.

children.title: Fallback Fonts
children.description: Replace Roku's system font with the fallback font provided by the Jellyfin server. Fallback fonts must be configured and enabled by the server admin for this to work. JellyRock will need to be restarted.

children.title: Hide Clock
children.description: Hide all clocks in JellyRock. JellyRock will need to be closed and reopened for changes to take effect.

children.title: Max Days Next Up
children.description: Set the maximum amount of days a show should stay in the 'Next Up' list without watching it.

children.title: Rewatching Next Up
children.description: Show already watched episodes in 'Next Up' sections.

children.title: Row Layout
children.description: Choose how rows are displayed throughout the app.

children.title: Theme Colors
children.description: Customize the app's color scheme. Choose a preset or create your own custom theme.

children.title: Theme
children.description: Select a color theme. Choose 'Custom' to manually set individual colors.

children.title: Background - Primary
children.description: Main background color. Default: 0D1117

children.title: Background - Secondary
children.description: Panel/card background color. Default: 161B22

children.title: Primary
children.description: Focus highlights and buttons. Default: 8B5CF6

children.title: Secondary
children.description: Progress bars and accents. Default: 3B82F6

children.title: Text - Disabled
children.description: Muted/disabled/inactive text. Default: 4A4A4A

children.title: Text - Primary
children.description: Main text color. Default: F0F0F0

children.title: Text - Secondary
children.description: Secondary text. Default: A8A8A8

children.title: Use Web Client's Home Section Arrangement
children.description: Make the arrangement of the Roku home view sections match the web client's home screen. JellyRock will need to be closed and reopened for change to take effect.

children.title: Libraries
children.description: Settings relating to the appearance of Library pages.

children.title: General
children.description: Settings relating to the appearance of pages in all Libraries.

children.title: Grid View Settings
children.description: Settings that apply when Grid views are enabled.

children.title: Item Count
children.description: Show item count in the library and index of selected item.

children.title: Item Titles
children.description: Select when to show titles.

children.title: Hide Taglines
children.description: Hides tagline text on details pages.

children.title: Return to Top
children.description: Use the replay button to slowly animate to the first item in the folder. (If disabled, the folder will reset to the first item immediately).

children.title: Movies
children.description: Settings relating to the appearance of pages in Movie Libraries.

children.title: Community and Critical Ratings
children.description: Ratings for how good a movie is.

children.title: Default View
children.description: Default view for Movie Libraries.

children.title: TV Shows
children.description: Settings relating to the appearance of pages in TV Libraries.

children.title: Blur Unwatched Episodes
children.description: Blur images of unwatched episodes.

children.title: Disable Community Rating for Episodes
children.description: Hide the star and community rating for episodes of a TV show. This is to prevent spoilers of an upcoming good/bad episode.

children.title: Disable Unwatched Episode Count
children.description: If enabled, the number of unwatched episodes in a series/season will be removed.
